MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN MEDIA (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 2 4 th DAY OF AUGUST 2020 
 
 Present 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan Director 
 Imran Ali Khan Director 
 
 Imran Ali Khan chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 AVAILMENT OF LOAN FROM ZAMEEN LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to avail a loan in the principal amount of AED 3,600,000 (Emirati Dirham Three Million Six Hundred Thousand) from Zameen Limited (“ Lender ”). The Board unanimously nominated Imran Ali Khan , Director of the Company, t o discuss, neg otiate , and accept this proposal . 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved by the Board that the Company avail a loan in the principal amount of AED 3,600,000 (Emirati Dirham Three Million Six Hundred Thousand) from the Lender . 
 
 Resolved further by the Board that Imran Ali Khan is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction . 
 
 
 
 
 _____________________________ 
 Company Secretary
